<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/api/package-api-assembled.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`, `packages/spec/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **144** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cdd4eea93811522cca145a0f24858def51443671` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1a17dab74385301324e630336650ddcf888d429f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/package-api-assembled.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts, packages/spec/src/index.ts + packages/spec/tsup.config.ts, packages/spec/README.md, content/docs/references/api/package-api-assembled.mdx, .changeset/25811-spec-shared-chunk-comments.md

Inputs read: card 25811 (body and all four comments: 6399839445, 6409955774, 6410056101, 6410580800); PR 25975 body, file list and the net diff against `main` (compare `main...1a17dab`: 3 commits, 5 files, +26/-11, mergeable clean); the 48 check-runs on the head: 41 success, 7 skipped (path-filtered or opt-in), 0 failure. Of the eight required contexts, seven conclude success and `Lint UI` concludes skipped, which is its path filter on a diff that touches no `ui/` path. The rest of the diff (the generated page and the changeset) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT; both are read here anyway because the three hunks make claims about them.

### ① Derived judgments

1. Accept-set: unchanged — right. The three hunks are comment text only: the file-header docblock of `index.ts`, the TSDoc on the exported `CONVERSIONS_BY_MAJOR` table in `registry.ts`, and the module docblock of `package-api-assembled.zod.ts`. No Zod schema, key, accepted value, export or conversion entry moves; the `registry.ts` hunk touches none of the `MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS` or `CONVERSIONS_BY_MAJOR` entries around it. `check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface` (inside the green `TypeScript Type Check` job) and `Spec property liveness` are green on the head.
2. The new sentences are true of the cited code — right. The published JS is `jsConfig` in `packages/spec/tsup.config.ts` (`splitting: true`, `esbuildPlugins: [oneModuleGraph, pureSchemaConstruction]`), and the `oneModuleGraph` docblock states the exact mechanism the hunks now cite: esbuild assigns a module to a chunk by file-level reachability, so an entry links every chunk its import graph touches, used or not. `packages/spec/README.md` (Export surfaces) says the same in the same words. The `splitting: false` that survives at `tsup.config.ts:472` belongs to `mainConfig`, the DTS pass and the single-entry test config, never the shipped JS, so the `registry.ts` hunk's new citation (`tsup.config.ts`, `oneModuleGraph`) is the right one and the old (`splitting: false`) was the wrong one.
3. The PURE-annotation reasoning in `registry.ts` still holds under the new wording — right. The unchanged consequence sentence (unmarked, the two initializers kept the whole table in every bundle of every entry whose graph reaches this module) is layout-independent: a consumer's bundle links the chunk whether it is shared or inlined, and `pure-schema-construction.test.ts` still pins the effect on the built `./shared` entry.
4. `index.ts` now dates the +60.1 KB `/shared` reading to the former per-entry bundles — right. The tsup docblock records the per-entry layout as the one measured on `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0`, which is after the #10096 ruling the reading came from; the standing-principle quotation itself is reproduced unchanged.
5. Generated page: `content/docs/references/api/package-api-assembled.mdx` differs by exactly the two regenerated lines of the TSDoc hunk and nothing else — right; `check:docs` runs inside the green `TypeScript Type Check` job, and the Docs Drift Check bot note on the PR (no anchor for the three source files) is about its own blind spot, not a drift.
6. Stale-phrase closure: on `origin/main` the grep hits for "self-contained bundle", "one flat file" and the comment-level "splitting: false" under `packages/spec/src`, `README.md` and `tsup.config.ts` are exactly the three lines the diff replaces (plus the `mainConfig` setting in item 2). The two comments the dev noted out of scope (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/tsup.config.ts:29`, `packages/types/tsup.config.ts:14`) describe builds that still set `splitting: false` (lines 46 and 24 of those files), so they are accurate and not a finding.
7. Governed surfaces: none of the five paths is a register row and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is green. The schema face (`packages/spec/src/**`) is what sets this review's tier, and this record is that review of record.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/25811-spec-shared-chunk-comments.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`; its body carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, matching the PR body's two line-initial declarations; no widening or narrowing arm, no BREAKING banner, so no ADR-0087 disposition marker is owed. `patch` is the right level: `Metadata-protocol: none` takes patch by the rule, and `skip-changeset` is reserved for a diff that publishes nothing from a released package. All three rewritten blocks are declaration-bearing doc comments (a file-header docblock, the docblock on an exported const, a module docblock), which the DTS pass carries into the shipped `files[]`; the dev's post-build grep of `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/api-assembled/index.d.ts` is the measured criterion the os-dev changeset rule names, and it outranks the fast-lane word for comments. `Check Changeset` is green. Clause-②: no is correct: nothing an author or consumer writes is accepted more or less widely than before.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions`: none declared, none found.

Deviations, each answered:
1. Commit trailers: all three commits end with the model-free pair (`Claude-Session:` plus `Co-authored-by: Claude`), which AGENTS.md requires over the dispatch order's model-named trailer — correct, no action.
2. Branch `claude/project-thread-mybepv` instead of an issue-named branch: Claim comment 6410056101 names this branch and the platform reason, and the check-runs `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` and `No other open PR may claim the same issue` are green — accepted as recorded.
3. One `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` ran in the shared seat checkout: it touched only gitignored `node_modules`, no file was edited there and nothing of it is in the diff — noted, no action.
4. No `skip-changeset` label: correct per ② above.
5. Three local gate families NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` run in `ci.yml` under the green `Build Core` lane, and `check-plugin-teardown-shape` (self-test and run) runs in `lint.yml` under the green `Lint & Repo Gates`, so the head's check-runs answer all three — no gap.

Out-of-scope finding (two tsup comments, carrier none): judged accurate in ① item 6; no card owed.
